stem.text: A ball of mass $m$ travelling at velocity $u$ collides with a stationary ball of mass $M$. After collision the two balls travel at velocities $v$ and $V$ respectively, in the directions shown.

stem.alt: Before collision: ball of mass m moving to the right at velocity u towards a stationary ball of mass M
After collision: ball m moving up and to the right at velocity v, 30 degrees above a horizontal dashed line; ball M moving down and to the right at velocity V, 40 degrees below the line

stem.text: A student writes three equations relating to the collision.
Which row in the table indicates the correct and incorrect equations?
